#/texts/7.label: paragraph
#/texts/7.full_gt_text: The undersigned is directed to say that with effect from 26th June, 1991 :-

#/texts/8.label: paragraph
#/texts/8.full_gt_text: (i) Prime Minister relinquished the additional charge of the office of Minister of Defence.

#/texts/9.label: paragraph
#/texts/9.full_gt_text: (ii) Shri Sharad Pawar assumed the office of Minister of Defence.

#/texts/10.label: paragraph
#/texts/10.full_gt_text: (iii) Shri Rameshwar Thakur assumed the office of Minister of State in the Ministry of Finance.

#/texts/11.label: paragraph
#/texts/11.full_gt_text: (iv) Smt. D.K. Tharadevi assumed the office of Minister of State in the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

#/texts/12.label: paragraph
#/texts/12.full_gt_text: (v) Shri S.B. Nyamagoudar assumed the office of Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Coal.

#/texts/13.label: paragraph
#/texts/13.full_gt_text: (vi) Shri S. Krishna Kumar, Minister of State in the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas also assumed additional charge of the office of Minister of State in the Ministry of Defence.

#/texts/14.label: paragraph
#/texts/14.full_gt_text: (vii) Kum. Mamta Banerjee, Minister of State in the Ministry of Human Resource Development (Department of Youth Affairs and Sports) also assumed additional charge of the office of Minister of State in the Ministry of Human Resource Development (Department of Women and Child Development).

#/texts/20.label: paragraph
#/texts/20.full_gt_text: All Members of the Council of Ministers.

#/texts/21.label: paragraph
#/texts/21.full_gt_text: Copy forwarded for information to : Deputy Chairman, Planning Commission.
